title: Find Recommendations by Category Prefix
real_world_story: A recommendation platform stores thousands of product names and categories. When a user starts typing a category or product prefix, the system needs to quickly find all matching items.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Available product names and a search prefix
real_world_connection.target_represents: Products whose names begin with the requested prefix
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: A Trie that stores product names character by character for efficient prefix-based searching

problem_statement: Given N product names and a prefix entered by the user, find all product names that begin with the given prefix. Print the matching product names in lexicographical order. If no product matches, print -1.
task: Use a Trie to efficiently retrieve all products whose names begin with the given prefix.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated product names. The third line contains the prefix to search for.
output_format: Print all matching product names in lexicographical order separated by spaces. If no product matches, print -1.
constraints: Product names and prefix contain only lowercase English letters

examples.input:
5
phone phonestand photo printer projector
pho
examples.explanation: The products phone, phonestand, and photo begin with the prefix pho.
No product name begins with the prefix smart.

expected_algorithm.name: Trie Operations
expected_algorithm.reason: A Trie allows product names to be stored character by character and makes prefix-based recommendation searches efficient.

complexity.where: T is the total length of all product names, P is the prefix length, and R is the total length of returned recommendations.

hint: Insert every product name into a Trie.
Traverse the Trie using the characters of the prefix.
If the prefix does not exist, return -1.
Collect all complete product names below the prefix node.
real_world_takeaway: Trie-based prefix searching is useful for autocomplete and recommendation systems where users expect relevant suggestions while typing.
